paper_000.pdf.title: V*: Guided Visual Search as a Core Mechanism in Multimodal LLMs
task_relevant_points: MLLMs lack visual search for precise grounding in high-resolution crowded scenes
Uses LLM-guided search, contextual cues, and visual working memory
Explicitly motivates iterative region localization and reintegration of searched evidence

paper_001.pdf.title: Generic Attention-model Explainability for Interpreting Bi-Modal and Encoder-Decoder Transformers
task_relevant_points: Attention heatmaps are legitimate interpretability artifacts for multimodal reasoning
Explains relevance propagation across multimodal transformer attention

paper_002.pdf.title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
task_relevant_points: Frozen vision encoders create an information bottleneck that limits fine-detail transfer
A lightweight bridge module can select useful visual features for language generation

paper_003.pdf.title: Monkey: Image Resolution and Text Label Are Important Things for Large Multi-modal Models
task_relevant_points: High image resolution and local patch processing improve detailed scene understanding
Combining global feature with local patches is a central comparison axis

contract_updates: Include at least one attention/saliency-style interpretability figure
Discuss frozen-encoder bottleneck and why crop-based zoom can help without training
